text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
――Efforia-san, are you done for the day?
Hey, hey, wanna go grab some ice cream together right now?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: An invitation.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
However, my instructor taught me that
'consistency is power.'

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Eh~ But our drill instructor also said,
"Taking a break is part of training!"

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: "Resting is part of training, too"...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
In that case, I shall accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
...
Which flavor should I choose for this one?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whatever flavor you like is fine, Efforia-san!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: My favorite flavor……

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Since you just finished training, how about blackcurrant?
I think I saw in a video that the nutrients help with fatigue~.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall go with that.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that was fast!
There's a bunch of other delicious stuff too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll go with this one.
Since you said it would be the more beneficial choice.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me. Would you happen to know of any stores
where I might purchase cassis ice cream?

One day, Efforia, seemingly on a break
from training, called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Yes. I wish to consume that in order to recover from fatigue.
choice_data_list: Eating your favorite foods really washes away the fatigue, huh?
I only know regular berry ice cream, but...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Does consuming things you "like"
actually aid in recovering from fatigue?
choice_data_list: Wait, isn't that why you're eating it?
Wait, isn't that why you're eating it?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
No.
I was told the ingredients were effective, so...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
If it's not something I "like,"
can I not expect any recovery from fatigue?
choice_data_list: No, I don't really think that's true, but……

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, as I thought,
I would like to consume cassis ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
To ask once more――do you happen to know
of any shops that sell cassis ice cream?
Seeing her ask so earnestly, I looked up some information about the ice cream shop and shared it with her.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Understood.
choice_data_list: If you're looking to recover from fatigue, how about some lemon sorbet?

text_block_list.text: I mention that lemons are rich in vitamins and citric acid, making them very effective for recovery from fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ――Let's go with that one, then.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is fine.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: I believe this will be beneficial, so I shall follow your advice.
